exclusions: unreferenced persistence schemas and internal event DTOs
limitations: No gRPC server or HTTP/WS adapter is implemented.
Observed request fields are not exhaustive validation schemas.
Unknown/dynamic values use Value/Struct; the report includes intermediate inference attempts.
TS number maps to double; integer semantics are not invented.
Heterogeneous unions, Date|string, runtime classes and tuples may use Value.
WS RPCs document request/reply semantics, not invented bidirectional streams. SSE and binary streaming endpoints require a transport adapter.
Server HTTP routes include permission-restricted handlers; listing an RPC does not grant access.
